question: In triangle PQR, ST is parallel to QR. If PS=5cm, SQ=10cm , and PT=6cm , find TR.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

According to the Basic Proportionality Theorem (BPT), since ST is parallel to QR, the sides are divided in the same ratio.

⇒ PS / SQ = PT / TR

⇒ 5 / 10 = 6 / TR

⇒ 1 / 2 = 6 / TR

⇒ TR = 12 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

In triangle PQR, line ST is parallel to the base QR.

Length of PS = 5 cm

Length of SQ = 10 cm

Length of PT = 6 cm
